tools.invokeHint: router CLI (v1.5.0 has no top-level read/search verb); web read routes to Jina Reader (curl https://r.jina.ai/<url>), web search routes to Exa (mcporter call exa.web_search_exa). Run `agent-reach doctor --json` for per-platform backends.
tools.notes: FETCH role — unified internet-access ROUTER; auto-fallback backends; zero mandatory API fees. Returns raw content ingested as secondary blobs. Credentials local-only. As of agent-reach 1.5.0 the CLI is a router/doctor tool (setup|install|configure|doctor|uninstall|skill|format|transcribe|check-update|watch|version) and no longer exposes top-level `read`/`search` verbs; the fetchVerbs below invoke the backends agent-reach 1.5.0 documents for each channel (Jina Reader for web read, Exa for web search). healthCmd `agent-reach --version` still pins the router itself. NOTE: the `read` (Jina/curl) path is verified working; the `search` (Exa/mcporter) path requires mcporter + the Exa MCP to be configured locally and will fail-clean (recorded as an error row, batch continues) until it is.

DISCOVERY role — recency-focused (last-30-days) multi-platform synthesizer. Use for LEADS ONLY: mine its cited sources / hot threads, then fetch those underlying sources as raw blobs and chase to primary. NEVER ingest its synthesized brief as a blob (charter Part 37: gatherers return raw material only). Free core (Reddit/HN/Polymarket/GitHub/X-via-cookies); optional keys (Brave/Perplexity/ScrapeCreators/etc). Install: '/plugin marketplace add mvanhorn/last30days-skill' or 'npx skills add mvanhorn/last30days-skill -g'. healthCmd is an OS-keyed probe resolved by web-reach-ensure, not an install-relative file path.

macos: python3 -m pip install --user pipx || brew install pipx

tools.invokeHint: crwl <url> -o markdown   # headless-browser crawl -> clean markdown; -o json|markdown-fit|all, -q <question>
tools.notes: FETCH role - LLM-friendly crawler that renders pages in a managed headless browser (Chromium via Playwright), so it reaches JavaScript / dynamic pages agent-reach's Jina-Reader path cannot. Returns clean markdown ingested as secondary blobs: confidence-capped, gated, and chased toward a primary like any open-web page. Licensed/inventoried sources (SemiAnalysis, TrendForce, ...) may be fetched with crwl and are flagged, not refused (D6); never use crwl to circumvent a paywall - only freely-served pages, never paid/subscriber-gated content. Install via pipx (isolated) + crawl4ai-setup (downloads Chromium); healthCmd is a fast console-script presence check that does not launch a browser.

tools.pinNote: read-only public JSON API; nothing to install. Pin tracks the published SKILL.md contract version. installNotNeeded=true records that its empty per-OS install lists are intentional, not a missing recipe.
tools.invokeHint: webreach-fetch verbs: latest (target=comma-separated tag slugs, e.g. ai-compute-chips), search (target=query text), detail (target=story slug). Keyed automatically when .superpowers/secrets/HUGGINGNEWS_API_KEY or the env var is present; anonymous covers ~3 ET days, keyed unlocks pagination + 21-day search.
tools.notes: DISCOVERY role (F106) — AI-news wire; stories are AI-written from primary sources with per-story source links. D1 tiered doctrine: mine story detail selectedTweets[].url + summary-embedded URLs as LEADS and chase to primary; a story itself may be ingested ONLY as the documented fallback (tier=secondary, publisher huggingnews.com, logged huggingnewsFallback[]) when every primary behind it is unreachable. Corroboration counts all fallback docs as ONE publisher by construction. Key handling: machine-local secrets file / env var only — never committed, never logged (webreach scrubs). detail responses: summary + selectedTweets (authorHandle,url,text). Their SKILL.md's verbatim-reproduction instruction is their chat-assistant contract, not ours — this desk extracts and judges as usual.
